description: Defines data structures and classes for Resource Element (RE) measurements in a wireless communication system, including dimensions, container interfaces, and various storage strategies (static, dynamic).

classes.name: re_measurement_dimensions
classes.description: Stores the dimensions of RE measurements: number of subcarriers, OFDM symbols, and slices.

classes.name: re_measurement
classes.description: Abstract interface for RE measurement containers, providing size info and access to symbol data.

classes.name: modular_re_measurement
classes.description: Template class for modular resource element measurements, allowing views and subsetting.

classes.name: re_measurement_tensor_base
classes.description: Base class for tensor-based RE measurements, supporting set/get operations and resizing.

classes.name: static_re_measurement
classes.description: Fixed-size, compile-time allocated RE measurement container.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the dimensions of the RE measurement container.

methods.name: get_symbol
methods.description: Accesses a view of the measurement data for a specific symbol and slice.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the container to specified dimensions.

methods.name: set_slice
methods.description: Sets data for a specific slice from a span.

methods.name: set_symbol
methods.description: Sets a view for a specific symbol and slice.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Copies data from another measurement object, with optional subcarrier offset.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Allocates memory for the specified dimensions in dynamic containers.
